data.description: During CI for Gerrit change 2249 the macos-latest/py3.13 pytest leg failed with 4 COLLECTION errors (not test failures; 900 passed): ModuleNotFoundError: 'rebar_reconciler.classify' is not a package, collecting tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/classify/{test_frozen_census,test_matrix,test_multipass_stateful,test_properties}.py. ROOT CAUSE (deterministic mechanism, non-deterministic trigger): the engine ships rebar_reconciler/classify.py as a MODULE, while the test tree tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/classify/ is a PACKAGE sharing the top-level name. _engine_module (src/rebar/_lib_ops.py) seeds sys.modules['rebar_reconciler'] = the ENGINE package; tests/unit/conftest.py::_bridge_reconciler_shadow_package() compensates by putting BOTH shadow-dir and engine-dir on __path__, but under some xdist worker orderings the engine package is seeded WITHOUT the shadow path before a classify test imports, so rebar_reconciler.classify resolves to the engine MODULE and the test package cannot collect. Passes locally (py3.12) and on the ubuntu legs; surfaced only on macos-py3.13. Adding two test files in change 2249 perturbed xdist work-distribution enough to surface this LATENT pre-existing collision; the classify dir is untouched by that change. FIX DIRECTION: harden _bridge_reconciler_shadow_package() to also repair the engine package's __path__ deterministically (append the shadow dir) regardless of seed order, OR rename one side to remove the module-vs-package name collision. Repro aid: run tests/scripts + tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/classify together under xdist -n and vary worker count.
data.title: xdist ordering flake: rebar_reconciler.classify module vs test-package shadow collision
